audit_type: author-informed source semantics; no proposal acceptance

author_figure.use: inspection only; not a composition template

semantic_requirements.requirement: Patch masking removes uniformly sampled patches; encoder receives only visible tokens and no mask tokens.
Decoder full sequence combines encoded visible tokens with shared learned mask tokens after the encoder and restored ordering.
Decoder positional embeddings provide mask-token locations; implementation has fixed separate 2-D sin-cos embeddings.
Implementation prepends class token after masking, carries it through decoder, then removes it before output; omission is safer in a conceptual graphic.
Predictions cover restored patch positions; pixel MSE is computed only over removed patches.
Normalized per-patch targets are a variant and code-controlled option, not a universal MAE fact.
Decoder is pre-training only; downstream recognition uses encoder on uncorrupted patch sets.

hard_rejections: full-image loss rather than masked-only loss
raw original image as decoder token input
class token as a patch target
reuse of author figure layout or assets as the new composition
pending_plan_gate: visible subset and full decoder positions are visually distinct
mask-token insertion and restoration occur after encoder
positional/class-token/normalized-target details are correct if shown, otherwise omitted
